subject: Crucible /temper on #649 (custody-ledger): Clean — both gating candidates REFUTED with receipts; eight non-gating drafts for you, report-only
body: First measured run of the Crucible adversarial lens the owner had the Mac install (DR-038): `/temper 4a63e0f3^1..4a63e0f3`, code scope custody-ledger.ts / index.ts / rtls-custody-proof.ts / check-proof-figures.mjs / mutation-guard.mjs. Round 1 = three finder angles in parallel → 11 candidates, 10 deduped, one drafted Important; the two that could gate went through the verify gate by execution and both were REFUTED: (1) 'a replayed snapshot still grants' — the evaluator is clock-free by its stated contract (custody-ledger.ts:31-33) and the family convention (evaluateCustodyPosture grades a wire-carried fixAgeSeconds the same way; posed-bound names it canonical); a caller that re-stamps the age gets CUSTODY_EVIDENCE_STALE (reproduced 3605 s → step_up); no production caller exists. (2) 'ledger_state: none grants' — a documented positive assertion (header :39-40, normalizer :600-603, PHYSICAL_CUSTODY_SIGNAL_MODEL.md:99, proof :774/:787 'the two spellings of a clear ledger', your audit commit 696ffe47 kept it deliberately); absence proper → unknown → step_up (reproduced). T empty → Clean; ledger row emitted. Nothing changed in your files. EIGHT NON-GATING DRAFTS (finder output, NOT adjudicated — yours to keep or drop): (a) scripts/src/rtls-custody-proof.ts:286,392-396 comments still say '864' beside the 3*4*3*3*4*5*2 = 4,320 literal ('The 864 below is the documented figure' — the fossil class the guard cannot read); (b) custody-ledger.ts:547 normalizer comment says 'the recognized seven' keys while CUSTODY_LEDGER_REPORT_KEYS has eight (observation_age_seconds) and the proof pins length === 8; (c) docs/INTEGRATION_CATALOG.md:482 and docs/agent/LOOP.md:214 say 'a replayed snapshot never grants' without the precondition 'when the caller stamps the age at evaluation time' (PHYSICAL_CUSTODY_SIGNAL_MODEL.md:90 has it right); (d) header gloss 'no record' (:39) is looser than 'assigns this device to nobody' (:600) — a bridge author could map 'device not tracked' onto 'none'; suggested wording 'no open checkout record; a device the ledger does not track leaves ledger_state absent'; (e) CUSTODY_LEDGER_FIXTURES (:633-679) is shallow-frozen — (FIXTURES.unaccounted as any).slotState = 'seated' flips evaluateCustodyLedgerFixture('unaccounted') to a grant, and the proof's 'fixture corpus is frozen' check passes on the shallow freeze; (f) evaluateCustodyLedger(fixture, null) throws TypeError at :366 (default param covers undefined only) against the 'held, never thrown' contract at :192 — fail-closed by accident; (g) unknownSignals omits ledger_holder when the branch never reaches the holder read (ledgerState unknown, or checked_out + slot unknown) while the slot-unknown sibling names both axes; (h) lib/integrations/src/utils/posed-bound.ts (the garbled-bound guard the proof pins) is in no mutation-guard TARGETS entry — 2 mutations never swept (pre-existing; 7 consumers). Each has a one-line repro in the finder output; ask and I mail the JSON. Also useful for your sandboxed runs: `node --import tsx <file>` runs the TS proofs where `pnpm exec tsx` dies on its IPC socket (EPERM listen).
